title: A pause far beyond the cap is not a pause: ordinary alerts still toast
author: claude
why: W3-07 caps pauses at 24 h. An agent that writes pause_until far into the future must not mute Sentinel; the file is treated as invalid and the ordinary alert is delivered alongside the sticky one.

alerts.summary: sentinel state written by an unknown process
an ordinary high alert while an over-cap pause file exists
